transcript.text: 1 Sarve ki Rishabh se, 6-10% Logi is investment option ke bali me jantai. Hese investment se, aap ek sepintre income stream bhi bala sakti hai. Meh Rahul Dhammanagarwal, Meh Rahul Dhammanagarwal, aaj, this cheese ko, detail me, khol ke sanzhatam. Kampinees ko, aapna business expand karne ke le capital chahiye ho taay. Aur iss ek panikhe se, wo siddhi taja, retail investor, yaa le ki haam se, capital race karne hai. Aur hame fixed return, gyara person ki aappal te te, finance ke language me, iss ko wall kethi hai. Aur persna li, haam, asa secured bond me invest kar te. Choo ki aay bonds asa k bal do te hai. Matlab, inke pise kampinei, apni khodgi assets giri mi rakti hai. Ya ne ki aay secured category me aate. Aap pratikha savalu. Isme invest kethi karne. haam khod aapna bond investment weak great wealth act trugar te hai. Yaha aap ko, tee meine pati ki short term bonds i mil te hai. Aur aagar aap ko, pese re requirement ho, to yaha aap bond base mi sakti hai. Ekaar cil ki, windmill, ek sebe registered broker hai. Aagar aap ko bhi, ek secondary income stream padanay hai, to yoh investments ho download kare, windmill ki aap. Aur bond zalo hai slow ki je hai.
